Marta N: quick heads-up — spotted a group of 9 mid-market accounts stalled after the second onboarding session. low activity, usage drop. thinking a short 'cohort surge' save plan.
Priya S: can you share the account list and the common friction points? UX? billing? integrations?
Marta N: list attached in drive (link). main signal: incomplete model pinning + unclear webhook setup. also 2 accounts flagged a possible downgrade request in next invoice.
Ben K: thanks. propose two tracks: 1) enablement micro-cohort (2-week live office hours + config checklist) 2) downgrade-swap path for low-touch customers with incentives. keep it short-term.
Marco L: +1. For downgrade path suggest: preserve ARR by offering a 'feature-limited retain' plan + 3-month discount, auto-reengage play after 60d. Also add quick migration docs.
cs-bot: automated alert: 9 accounts, predicted churn risk 0.64, next_renewal_window: 30d-60d
Priya S: can we capture feedback during office hours and create a one-pager of common blockers? that'll help product and docs.
Marta N: yes. action items (brief):
```
- Owner: Priya S — assemble blocker themes + one-pager — due 1719880000
- Owner: Marco L — draft downgrade-swap email + offer — due 1719860000
- Owner: Ben K — schedule 2x office hours next week (cohort slots) — due 1719850000
- Owner: Marta N — prepare account list & handoff notes — done
```
Ben K: capacity note — I can run two 45m sessions Tue/Wed 11a PT. who else can co-host? @Priya S? @Marco L?
Priya S: I can co-host Wed slot. will add a short survey form to capture 'why' and basic NPS.
Marco L: I'll draft migration doc and a short FAQ for the downgrade plan. share by tomorrow EOD.
Marta N: nice. one more: tag each ticket with `cs:micro-cohort-171980` so we can report on outcomes. :memo:
Priya S: ack. will create tickets and add to shared board. can someone own tracking metrics (activation %, downgrade conversions, reactivation at 30/90d)?
Ben K: I'll own the metrics dashboard. will add a simple sheet and hook it into the console for token/active-user snapshots.
Marta N: perfect. follow-ups: sync Thurs 10a PT. aim: convert at least 4 of 9 to retained or committed renewals. :crossed_fingers:
cs-bot: reminder set for thread follow-up at 1719910000
Marco L: thanks team — moving to #customer-success ops board. will ping when docs live.
Priya S: thanks — will DM owners the forms. :wave:
